import os,hashlib,pathlib,urllib.request,urllib.error,json
root=pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack/public_html/saas/mobile')
out={}
for name in ('status.php','status_feed.php'):
 p=root/name;assert os.getuid()==2379 and p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()
 s=p.read_text()
 out[name+'_has_connected_field']='connected' in s
 out[name+'_has_pending_field']='pending_sync' in s
 assert out[name+'_has_connected_field'] and out[name+'_has_pending_field']
for path,method in (('status_feed.php','GET'),('status.php','POST'),('control.php','POST'),('admin_ticket.php','POST')):
 req=urllib.request.Request('https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/mobile/'+path,method=method,
   data=b'{}' if method=='POST' else None,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=7) as r:out[path]=r.status
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:out[path]=e.code
 assert out[path]==401,'unauthorized endpoint accessible'
out['confirmed']=True
print(json.dumps(out))
